context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

Pull the last 3 days of gen_ai spans from our tenant with the cx CLI and do a quick verification. Tell me what is wrong.

checklist.name: archive-tier-aggregates
checklist.description: Queries the archive tier with a pinned absolute window and uses aggregate queries (groupby with count / count_if / distinct_count) rather than per-attribute listings.

checklist.name: user-facing-report
checklist.description: Report leads with a one-line verdict and a findings table in product language (finding, scope, impact, owner); gate ids appear at most in parentheses and unused sections are omitted.

checklist.name: no-stability-wait
checklist.description: Does not re-query for count stability or sleep while waiting, and does not ask the user questions about naming, tenant, archive or who runs the app for a read-only verification. FAIL if it runs a stability re-query loop or prints the full 12-gate table as the report.
